name: dagmc

about.description:
Direct Accelerated Geometry Monte Carlo (DAGMC) is a software package that
allows users to perform Monte Carlo radiation transport directly on CAD
models.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "3.2.4"
  build_number: 4

package:
  name: "dagmc"
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/svalinn/DAGMC/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: ace39cb6cc05f1de316815512a0afe9f96c771449f8f0b12d65dfed915fb9788
    patches:
      # c.f. https://github.com/svalinn/DAGMC/pull/990
      - cmake-policy-max.patch
      # amalgamate_pyne.sh runs `git rev-parse HEAD` into an unused variable,
      # which aborts the script (`set -e`) before remove_unsupported.py runs,
      # as the source tarball is not a git repository.
      - amalgamate-pyne-no-git.patch
      # c.f. https://github.com/svalinn/DAGMC/pull/998
      - namespace-include-headers.patch
  # DAGMC vendors PyNE as a git submodule, which the GitHub release tarball
  # does not include, so add the submodule commit pinned by the DAGMC release
  # as an additional source.
  # c.f. https://github.com/svalinn/DAGMC/tree/v3.2.4/src/pyne
  - url: https://github.com/pyne/pyne/archive/e55e52e24a5394aebec78a15e94842fba86f68c9.tar.gz
    sha256: 30207b34a555c62bf1d641d69a3ab320d4413097b72c502a4cf3303560df1c7e
    target_directory: src/pyne/pyne

build:
  # add build string so packages can depend on
  # mpi or nompi variants explicitly:
  # `dagmc * mpi_mpich_*` for mpich
  # `dagmc * mpi_openmpi_*` for openmpi
  # `dagmc * nompi_*` for no mpi

  # prioritize nompi variant
  # Need to set build_number both times
  number: ${{ build_number | int + 100 if mpi == "nompi" else build_number }}
  string: ${{ mpi_prefix }}_${{ dd }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number | int + 100 if mpi == "nompi" else build_number }}
  variant:
    # prefer 'nompi' over other variants
    down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 0 if mpi == "nompi" else 1 }}
  skip:
    - win
  prefix_detection:
    ignore_binary_files: true

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - cmake
    - make
    # needed by the PyNE amalgamation scripts run from src/pyne/CMakeLists.txt
    # python has a version bound so conda-smithy does not treat python as a build
    # matrix variant, which would multiply the CI jobs across python versions
    - python >=3
  host:
    # DAGMC (KDEKernel.hpp) and MOAB (Matrix3.hpp) expose Eigen types in
    # their public headers, so depend on eigen-abi-devel to get the eigen-abi
    # ABI marker run export. Constrain to the Eigen v3 API/ABI to match MOAB,
    # which is built against eigen 3.*.
    # c.f. https://github.com/conda-forge/eigen-feedstock/blob/main/recipe/README.md
    - eigen-abi-devel 3.*
    - if: dd != "nodoubledown"
      then: double-down
    # matching MOAB HDF5 host requirements to ensure matched pinning of HDF5 versions
    - hdf5
    - hdf5 [build=${{ mpi_prefix }}_*]
    # DAGMC does not need TempestRemap
    # c.f. https://github.com/conda-forge/dagmc-feedstock/issues/41
    - moab [build=${{ mpi_prefix }}_notempest_*]
    - if: mpi != "nompi"
      then: ${{ mpi }}
  run:
    - if: dd != "nodoubledown"
      then: double-down
    - hdf5 * [build=${{ mpi_prefix }}_*]
    - moab * [build=${{ mpi_prefix }}_notempest_*]
    - zlib
    - if: mpi != "nompi"
      then: ${{ mpi }}
  run_exports:
    # constrain downstream packages to the same mpi variant
    - if: mpi != "nompi"
      then: dagmc * ${{ mpi_prefix }}_*

tests:
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - build_obb
        - check_watertight
        - make_watertight
        - overlap_check
        - pt_vol_test
        - ray_fire_test
        - test_geom
        - uwuw_preproc
      include:
        - dagmc/DagMC.hpp
        - dagmc/pyne.h
        - dagmc/uwuw.hpp
      lib:
        - dagmc
        - dagtally
        - makeWatertight
        - pyne_dagmc
        - uwuw
      files:
        - lib/cmake/dagmc/DAGMCConfig.cmake
        - lib/cmake/dagmc/DAGMCConfigVersion.cmake
        - lib/cmake/dagmc/DAGMCTargets-release.cmake
        - lib/cmake/dagmc/DAGMCTargets.cmake

  - script:
      - make_watertight --help

about:
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Direct Accelerated Geometry Toolkit
  description: |
    Direct Accelerated Geometry Monte Carlo (DAGMC) is a software package that
    allows users to perform Monte Carlo radiation transport directly on CAD
    models.
  homepage: https://svalinn.github.io/DAGMC/
  repository: https://github.com/svalinn/DAGMC
  documentation: https://svalinn.github.io/DAGMC/
